visualCharacteristics.purpose: customer Q&A list with answer counts and answer buttons, plus optional header bar

contentPattern.structure: optional header row (| Questions | Ask a question link |), then one row per question: | author · date | question | answer count | answer link |; a links-only row is an actions bar

usage: PDP Q&A sections and their empty state.
reuseGuidance: Use ask-button-only for the empty state, header-bar for the title bar.
